instruction:
Single Storey Event Pavilion IFC And Revit Plan Sheet PDF

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. In Revit, create a single-storey event pavilion, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a one-page Revit plan sheet as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf is at least 200 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 3 IfcSpace entities, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcRoof, 1 IfcDoor entity, and 3 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token event at least once, storage at least once, and toilet at least once.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains exactly 1 page exported from a Revit sheet.
8. The extracted text from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf contains the case-insensitive tokens A101 PAVILION PLAN, Event Room, Storage, and Toilet.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
